tool.name: OGS: createTetgenSmeshFromRasters
tool.description: Creates a boundary representation for a layered 3D mesh in *.smesh-format.
tool.command: : > 'raster_list.txt'; #for $item in $raster_list ln -sf '$item' '$item.element_identifier'; echo '$item.element_identifier' >> 'raster_list.txt'; #end for ln -sf '$input_mesh_file' 'input_mesh_file.vtu'; createTetgenSmeshFromRasters $ascii_output #if str($thickness) --thickness '$thickness' #end if --raster-list 'raster_list.txt' --input-mesh-file 'input_mesh_file.vtu' --output-mesh-file output_1.smesh

param.label: ascii output
param.help: Write VTU output in ASCII format.

param.label: thickness
param.help: The minimum thickness of a layer to be integrated at any given location

param.label: raster list
param.help: Input (.vtu). An ascii-file containing a list of raster files, starting from top (DEM) to bottom.

param.label: input mesh file
param.help: Input (.vtu | .msh). The file name of the 2D input mesh

tool.help: Creates a boundary representation for a layered 3D mesh in \*.smesh-format. This boundary representation can be used with the TetGen Tetrahedral Mesh Generator to create 3D meshes of the given geometry at arbitrary resolutions and with varying properties. Details on command line switches and possible parametrisation can be found in the TetGen User's Manual. Supported raster formats are ArcGIS ascii rasters (\*.asc), Surfer Grids (\*.grd) and XYZ raster files (\*.xyz). Only input meshes consisting of line and triangle elements are currently supported as mapping of quads might result in invalid mesh elements.
